title: 第489章 一意孤行
slug: 天赋太差全凭系统黑化
content_zh:
欧阳冷傲被轰倒在结界光幕之下，可好歹是承受住了凤凰挽歌灭世杀的攻击。
正当欧阳冷傲以为成功阻挡了林雲的黑刀乱刃三千世界杀伐攻击的时候，那道血红色的凤凰虚影竟涅槃重生，再度出现在林雲的眼前。
可怕的凤凰虚影爆发出更加强横的威压，与之前的凤凰挽歌相比，虚影凤凰变得更加狂暴，犹如升级一般。
林雲利用空间领域轻易抵挡下欧阳冷傲的虚空神剑，可是欧阳冷傲的空间领域却无法阻挡林雲的凤凰挽歌灭世杀。
向来高傲无比的欧阳冷傲在此刻竟然出现了一丝怀疑，甚至怀疑自己的武道历程。身为黑影王朝最大的家族势力，欧阳冷傲拥有的修行资源比林雲高出数百倍，千倍，乃至万倍！
可自己却无法抵挡下林雲的刀锋，欧阳冷傲身上的气息疯狂的溃散，眼神变得迷茫起来。
天地间虚影凤凰不断凝聚，恐怖的神威风暴在虚影凤凰周身肆虐，可是欧阳冷傲的注意力已经不在林雲的刀锋攻击之上了，此刻的欧阳冷傲显然心态崩溃了。
三大家家主望着擂台上风云突变的场景，各个无比惊骇。黑影大陆最具天赋实力的欧阳冷傲竟然被林雲打得信心全无。
这种结果是谁都没有想到的，即使欧阳庄主都没有想到会出现这种结果。欧阳庄主一直将冷傲当成山庄继承人来培养我，欧阳冷傲也不负众望，从小到大在同级别境界对手中就没有败过阵。
今日欧阳冷傲不断被林雲击败，甚至是完败！林雲的武境只是圣境一重天而已，这对从来没有失败过的欧阳冷傲简直是晴天霹雳，数万年的修行心境轰然倒塌！
姑苏明月原以为林雲与欧阳冷傲的对决将会是火山撞地球一般的激烈，没想到林雲竟如此强势的击败欧阳冷傲，丝毫没有给欧阳冷傲一丝机会。
姑苏明月喃喃说道，林雲轻松击败今日的欧阳山庄继承人，并豪言要带走上官玉儿，这对于欧阳家绝对是不能忍受的侮辱。
content_en:
Ouyang Lengao was knocked down under the barrier of light, but at least he withstood the attack of Phoenix Elegy.
Just when Ouyang Lengao thought he had successfully blocked Lin Yun's Black Blade Chaos Blade Three Thousand Worlds killing attack, the blood-red phoenix shadow unexpectedly reborn from nirvana and appeared in front of Lin Yun's eyes again.
The terrifying phoenix phantom burst out with more tyrannical pressure. Compared with the previous Phoenix Elegy, the phantom phoenix became more violent, as if it had been upgraded.
Lin Yun used the space domain to easily resist Ouyang Lengao's Void Divine Sword, but Ouyang Lengao's space domain could not stop Lin Yun's Phoenix Elegy to destroy the world.
Ouyang Lengao, who had always been extremely arrogant, actually had a trace of doubt at this moment, and even doubted his own martial arts journey. As the largest family power in the Black Shadow Dynasty, Ouyang Lengao has hundreds of times, a thousand times, or even ten thousand times more cultivation resources than Lin Yun!
But he couldn't resist Lin Yun's blade. The aura on Ouyang Lengao's body dissipated crazily, and his eyes became confused.
The phantom phoenix in the sky and the earth continues to condense, and the terrifying divine power storm rages around the phantom phoenix, but Ouyang Leng'ao's attention is no longer on Lin Yun's blade attack. At this moment, Ouyang Leng'ao's mentality has obviously collapsed.
The heads of the three families looked at the sudden change in the arena, and they were all horrified. Ouyang Lengao, the most talented person in the Black Shadow Continent, was beaten by Lin Yun and lost all his confidence.
No one expected this result, not even the owner of the village Ouyang expected this result. The owner of Villa Ouyang has always regarded Leng Ao as the heir to the Villa to train me. Ouyang Leng Ao has lived up to expectations. He has never been defeated by opponents of the same level since he was a child.
Today, Ouyang Lengao was constantly defeated by Lin Yun, even completely defeated! Lin Yun's martial arts realm was only the first level of the holy realm. This was like a bolt from the blue to Ouyang Leng'ao, who had never failed before. His tens of thousands of years of cultivation state of mind suddenly collapsed!
Gusu Mingyue originally thought that the duel between Lin Yun and Ouyang Leng'ao would be as fierce as a volcano hitting the earth. She did not expect that Lin Yun would defeat Ouyang Leng'ao so powerfully without giving Ouyang Leng'ao a chance.
Gusu Mingyue murmured that Lin Yun easily defeated today's heir to Ouyang Villa and boldly announced that he would take Shangguan Yu'er away. This was absolutely an intolerable insult to the Ouyang family.
